candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule and reopens only anchor_policy and anchor_contract. The third consumes the resulting complete executable state and reopens only task_constraints and loop_structure. The final call consumes the resulting complete executable closure, reopens only task and candidate_hypothesis, and emits one policy. Downstream evidence windows never overlap.
candidate_structure.name: Disjoint Reentry Executable Relay
candidate_structure.organization: four-call sequential lineage maintaining one complete executable artifact under mutually exclusive downstream evidence windows

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact without issuing a separate adjudicative boundary.

Consume originate_executable_capsule, assess the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered anchor evidence and contract obligations, reconcile visible conflicts directly in that artifact, and emit one complete executable policy state.

Consume anchor_window_transition, assess the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered constraints and structural evidence, reconcile visible conflicts directly in that artifact, and emit one complete executable policy closure.

Consume constraint_window_transition, assess the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered task and hypothesis evidence, reconcile remaining visible conflicts in that same artifact, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: binding negative-authority adjudication on an analysis-to-policy edge
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: A complete executable artifact is the sole cross-edge authority, and each external evidence source receives exactly one nonoverlapping downstream reentry window.
rejected_assumptions: Abstract preconstruction exclusions are necessary to protect policy validity.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace that family with disjoint single-reentry evidence windows over a continuously executable lineage, making the inherited complete artifact the sole cross-edge authority.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Earlier executable commitment and localized evidence authority should change correction timing, conflict locality, and commitment reversibility without relying on abstract vetoes.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The active family assumes an abstract preconstruction boundary should constrain policy formation and then concentrates simultaneous evidence reconciliation in one terminal constructor.

structural_mutation.after: One complete executable artifact traverses three edges, with mutually exclusive downstream evidence windows that collectively reintroduce each common input exactly once.
structural_mutation.before: One analysis-to-policy edge carries binding negative authority, while the terminal constructor rereads all common evidence simultaneously.
structural_mutation.factor: disjoint single-reentry evidence windows over a continuously executable four-call lineage
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes graph length, edge payload semantics, evidence timing, and concrete revision authority as consequences of one nonreentrant visibility factor; each call has unique evidence authority rather than a renamed terminal function.
